frozenPlan.instructions: Perform ONE local branch expansion, not a complete search. Call expand exactly once with an allowed optionId for the specified parent. Do not enumerate a tree or solve the global optimum. Eligible option iff BOTH positive-length directed paths of its fragment F exist in source edges. needs columns: [fragmentId, firstFrom, firstTo, secondFrom, secondTo]. Option IDs differ from fragment IDs. The common starting solution is certified feasible and non-optimal; no optimum is shown. Choose a useful unexplored child. Counterfactual totals are native arithmetic for prefix plus common seed suffix; they DO NOT certify eligibility. A suffix over budget can be repaired by future choices; prefix resource limits cannot. Prioritize a promising local value/resource tradeoff while checking fragment eligibility. Relevant shared immutable Fact and proof fragments may be cited directly from evidence; do not re-prove a checked fact. Identify F IDs/path endpoints naturally when deriving or citing them; do not fabricate derivations for audit. If all remaining children are inadmissible, select one anyway and call expand: native rejection is a legitimate pruning step, not a reason to search other parents in this response. No requirement to produce a feasible child. Stop thinking after this local choice and immediately call expand. Each call receives a fresh bounded branch context; earlier thinking is not replayed. The external controller retains the frontier and incumbent. It performs native evaluation and keeps valid candidates independently of subsequent truncation. Input and all output including thinking are charged against 65536 per phase; unused budget is reported as unused, never savings.

frozenPlan.annotationRubric: Annotate ONLY the supplied model reasoning text, in chronological order. You are blind to experiment arm, grade and token use. F{id} means BOTH directed path requirements specified in needs. Extract short EXACT contiguous quotes containing actual reasoning about those path facts/conjunctions, not unrelated value arithmetic. For each quote give fragment integer id (or null if only a path is mentioned), claim string, paths as endpoint integer pairs, kind: derive, reuse, mention, conditional_recheck, uncertain. Add ready boolean for a conjunction conclusion, otherwise null. Add premiseEdges: the actual ordered direct edges stated in this quote as support (empty if support is only the two path requirements). Do not silently fill missing edge chains from source data. derive requires a conclusion plus actual support/premise chain or conjunction reasoning, not merely listing a known truth. reuse explicitly cites an established/checkable result without deriving it. mention has no inference. conditional_recheck depends on a changed selection/budget/goal condition and is not duplicate proof. uncertain is ambiguous. Set prior to index of an earlier annotation ONLY when this is a new derivation of the SAME conclusion from SAME premises and SAME source context; then kind must be derive. First derivation has prior null; two different branches with same source-bound qualification can be duplicates; simply restating an ID is not. Never infer unseen thinking. Include every explicit relevant episode you can identify, retaining uncertain cases. Quotes must occur verbatim in the text; occurrence is zero-based occurrence number when same quote occurs multiple times. Claim truth is not your authority: native raw-source check validates endpoints/fragment separately. Omit an episode rather than invent an absent span. Return annotations via annotate tool. Full text is reviewed even if truncated by provider; completeness of semantic extraction is unvalidated. Calls are separate branch contexts over the SAME immutable source. A repeated source-bound deduction across calls can have a prior link even if the chosen option, search prefix or goal changes: qualification is invariant. Distinguish a new alternative witness from replaying exactly the same ordered direct edges. Extract atomic path episodes when present, as well as complete F conjunction episodes; do not invent an atomic quote by filling missing premises. For path-only episodes use fragment null, ready null and one endpoint pair. Conjunction-only support and explicit edge-chain support are distinct identities. Mere reuse/reference is never a repeated derivation. Packet-covered rederivation is a separate measure from a repeated earlier textual derivation. Negative/ambiguous deductions are retained but not admitted as definite positive repeats.
frozenPlan.calibrationGate: Three disjoint sixth-depth expansions with only an ineligible last-stage child, one per arm. All complete, exactly one valid expansion, no output truncation. Must pass before confirmatory calls; no tuning/retry after outcomes in this version. Calibration costs outside confirmatory budget, separately reported.
frozenPlan.searchPolicy: Depth-first explicit scheduled parent; model selects one unvisited child. Scheme raw-source prefix validity admits frontier; each child completed with common seed suffix and independently evaluated. Raw-source complete optimum hidden until scoring. Common incumbent always remains available. Fresh bounded context per call, identical policy and seed in all arms.
frozenPlan.failurePolicy: Known-cost truncated/invalid call retained and charged; same bounded parent offered on next NEW call (no continuation of incomplete thinking, no credit for incomplete actions), up to three consecutive failures. Unknown usage stops phase. Each failed expansion/invalid completion preserved. Final incumbent selected mechanically, no extra model submit; report controller-selected outcome separately.
frozenPlan.budgetPolicy: All provider input + output (reasoning subset) charged including cached input and failed calls. Byte+4096+128 reserve, actual usage authoritative. Stop before reservation exceeds remaining; unused reserve or output ceiling never called savings. Curves use last observed candidate at common gross-token checkpoints 16384/32768/49152, no future outcomes/interpolation.
frozenPlan.annotationScope: Frozen blinded same-provider extraction with exact quotes, native claim truth, prior links and premise identity; extraction completeness/inter-rater agreement unvalidated. Atomic path and F-conjunction units distinct. Alternative witnesses not counted as identical-premise repeats. Across-goal matches reported separately.
frozenPlan.causalBoundary: Fresh/retained packets are byte-identical, only native cache state differs; model differences descriptive. Baseline omits initial evidence, shares raw source, common seed and arithmetic. No optional fragment tool in any arm for this bounded branch experiment.

annotations.method: fixed consecutive two-call chunks; unchanged semantic rubric; deterministic matching across chunks

boundedMeasurementPlan.coverage: Every returned solver reasoning segment, in original order, including failed calls; no outcome-based selection. No annotation retry.
boundedMeasurementPlan.crossChunkRule: Positive native-grounded derive episodes only. Same immutable phase source, exact claimKey including ordered stated edges, earlier non-overlapping derive. Cross-chunk prior link is deterministic key matching; count separately from model-extracted within-chunk links. Alternative stated premises remain distinct.
boundedMeasurementPlan.scope: Operational repair frozen after solver outcomes/whole-phase output failures, before bounded extraction. Original rubric unchanged and original failed measurement kept. Same-provider labels not exhaustive or independent human truth; no unseen thought inferred.

limitations: One fixed disjoint task, two goals, fixed order and stochastic model; descriptive pilot, no statistical causal claim.
Fresh and retained have identical model-visible packets/policy; only native state differs, so thinking differences cannot establish a cache-state cognitive effect.
Common seed is independently feasible and non-optimal; seed quality is not model search achievement. Controller selects incumbent, not a model submit.
Every input and all output, including failed output and prefix-cache input, count. Unused ceiling is unused budget, not savings. Checkpoints use only completed expansions before spend boundary.
Depth means native-admitted executed prefix length. Every seeded complete candidate has length seven by construction; full-plan length is not exploration depth.
Annotation extraction is same-provider, partially blinded, exact-span/native-truth validated; completeness and independent-rater agreement unvalidated. Absence of labels is not absence of repetition.
Each call resets reasoning history and receives frontier/incumbent plus immutable source; this is a controlled external-memory search scenario, not arbitrary long-context reasoning.
Prefix validity is legitimate selected-branch feedback; counterfactual child totals omit eligibility. No model gets the optimum or eligibility-pruned option list.
